tabData.title: Agents at Large – Ten Things You Need to Know About AI Agents at LBG
tabData.text:
Rich Bates and Huw Jones will share their key insights from the past six months of building Envoy and advancing Lloyds’ pro‑code agent development capability. They will offer their perspective on what it takes to design, scale and govern AI agents.  

 Critical Skill : **AI Strategy / Design & Implementation**
tabData.name: Rich Bates​ & Huw Jones

tabData.title: Helping our Engineers to be More Productive
tabData.text:
We will show you how we are making it easier for engineers using the IDP to focus on what matters to them... developing code and making their apps available to customers. We will also show you a glimpse into the future of development using AI with the IDP.  

 Critical Skill : **Agile Methodology & Tools**
tabData.name: Asa Harland & Dan Davy

tabData.title: Skills of Today == Engineers of Tomorrow
tabData.text:
An inclusive exploration of how today’s skills and ways of working, across technical and non‑technical roles alike, are shaping the engineers of tomorrow.  

 Critical Skill : **Product Innovation & Development / Customer Centricity**
tabData.name: Stu Fosker

tabData.title: Insights from LBGs Emerging Tech Pioneers: Developing a Digital Asset Proposition in 8 weeks;
tabData.text:
We are a team of tech, data and business graduates and placement students who were challenged to:​ 

 Develop a new D2C investment proposition enabling multiple investors to fund a single borrower through fractional ownership of an asset.​ 

  Develop tokenisation infrastructure to enable fractional ownership via blockchain-based tokens, on-chain governance and automated yield distributions, as well as secondary market access for liquidity and diversification. During this talk we will share our learnings on developing real world propositions leveraging tokenisation.​  

 Critical Skill : **Product Innovation & Development​ / Digital Asset Trading​**
tabData.name: Bea Schofield​ & team

tabData.title: If You’re Not Talking to Customers, You’re Guessing
tabData.text:
Talking to customers isn’t optional. Dan and Sufyan reveal how evidence beats assumptions, sharing practical discovery habits that help teams learn faster, reduce waste, and build products people truly value.  

 Critical Skill : **Customer Centricity**
tabData.name: Dan Bateman & Sufyan Iqbal

tabData.title: Women ConnecTech​ - A Tour of Tech Tools
tabData.text:
Join Women ConnecTech for this lightning-style session on introductions to Python, SQL, Power BI, and mobile native development.  Whether you're curious about coding, want to understand how data is transformed into insight, or simply want to broaden your tech awareness, this session is designed to demystify core tools used across modern engineering and analytics teams. Expect real examples, practical explanations, and insights from colleagues who use these tools every day.  Perfect for anyone looking to build confidence, explore new skills, or discover their next learning pathway.  

 Critical Skill : **Digital Literacy / Software Engineering**
tabData.name: Patrick So​, Molly Richards​, Halyna Maslak​ & Emily Manton

tabData.title: Resilience Reimagined: Delivering the expected today and enabling innovation for tomorrow
tabData.text:
This session explores how we deliver consistently for customers, the market and the UK — even when the unexpected happens. Through the lenses of people, data, technology, security and third parties, we’ll look at what we do today and where sharper focus on simplicity, accountability and performance is needed to succeed as a true national champion.  

 Critical Skill : **Customer Centricity​**
tabData.name: Emma Mansfield

tabData.title: How CSO are shifting from 'computer says no...' to 'yes, let's go!'
tabData.text:
An insight into the world of web access at LBG, and how the Chief Security Office have listened to you, the Customer, and shifted their mindset (and technology) to meet the needs of business areas, enabling colleagues to achieve their deliverables, with a faster and more frictionless experience for all.   
 Critical Skill : **Customer Centricity**
tabData.name: Joseph Hirst & Katie Harrison

tabData.title: Decoding Skills: Data, Levels, and a Smarter Path to Building Skills
tabData.text:
Skills conversations are everywhere – but how do we make them meaningful? This talk breaks down how skills data and skill levels really work, why they matter, and how we can use them to make smarter, fairer decisions about learning and development. 

 Critical Skill : **Continued Learning / Software Engineering​**
tabData.name: Al Watkins, Natalie Chadwick & Kelly Evans

tabData.title: Pegasus: Our Framework for Evaluating GenAI Systems at LBG
tabData.text:
An introduction to Pegasus - LBG’s unified framework for evaluating GenAI systems - showing why rigorous measurement is essential, how our evaluation approaches work in practice, what capabilities Pegasus provides today across prompts, RAG, summarisation, safety, AI agent, and conversational behaviour, and how teams can use it through a live, end‑to‑end demo.  

 Critical Skill : **AI / ML Solution Design**
tabData.name: Chi Zhang

tabData.title: Improving our work practices: Practical insights from Behavioural Science
tabData.text:
A quick introduction to behavioural science and how it can be applied to change colleague & customer behaviour. We will also share insights from a pilot we ran to reduce time spent in meetings.  

 Critical Skill : **Business Readiness & Adoption / Customer Centricity**
tabData.name: Georgina Bremner

tabData.title: Data over gut instinct - how Technology Data Insights drives your Technology Strategy
tabData.text:
TDI is the data engine guiding delivery of the technology strategy. In this talk, Tech Strategy & Insights product owner Oliver O'Neill will share how technology insights are at your fingertips and how we need to prepare for an AI-first data product proposition​.​  

 Critical Skill : **Technology Intelligence / Product Innovation & Development**
tabData.name: Oliver O'Neill

tabData.title: Unlocking the power of JIRA Cloud & Confluence Cloud
tabData.text:
See how Jira and Confluence behave when Cloud finally lets them be best mates. We’ll show how work moves effortlessly from ticket → doc → board → whiteboard without you juggling tabs or hunting links. Expect fast demos, clever patterns, and a peek at the roadmap shaping Cloud‑powered engineering. If you’ve ever thought “surely this should be easier,” this session is for you.  

 Critical Skill : **Agile Methodology & Tools**
tabData.name: Hilary Lanham

tabData.title: No More Science Projects: AI Agents That Earn Their Keep
tabData.text:
This is a fun, fast‑paced look at what happens when AI starts delivering the goods. We’ll zip through Concept → Customer → Cashflow, exploring how real‑world agents can delight customers, lighten the load for colleagues, and make more then just noise. Playful, practical, and proudly non‑corporate; this is AI with its sleeves rolled up 😁  

 Critical Skill : **AI Literacy**
tabData.name: Omar Rafiq

tabData.title: Next-Level Collaboration: Confluence, Jira & AI at LBG​​
tabData.text:
We’re taking teamwork to new heights! With Confluence now in the cloud and Jira soon to follow, discover how these tools can transform the way we work at LBG. This session will introduce the cloud features, highlight key differences from the old setup, and give you a sneak peek at Rovo—Atlassian’s new AI assistant that’s set to change the way we find, create, and collaborate.​  

 Critical Skill : **Agile Methodology & Tools​**
tabData.name: Hilary Lanham, Adam Wood (Atlassian) & Richard Morton (Atlassian)

tabData.title: Agentic AI move from Experiments to Production
tabData.text:
2026 is the turning point for production‑grade agentic AI, enabling Hyperdistributed Intelligence through the combined power of AI and APIs, while strengthening security, resiliency, efficiency, and governance. 

 Critical Skill : **Solution & Technical Architecture​ / Product Innovation & Development**
tabData.name: Varsha Nogaja & Azahar Machwe

tabData.title: Dream it. See it. Ship it - in 60 Minutes with Copilot + GitHub Spark
tabData.text:
What if a product idea in the morning could become a shareable prototype by lunch?​ In this fast‑paced, live build, we’ll sprint through the product lifecycle — Discovery → Design → Development → Deployment → Marketing — using Microsoft 365 Copilot for research, framing and content, and a lightweight dev path to ship something real. You’ll see how to turn market signals into a lean value proposition, transform it into screens, generate working code with AI assistance, and get it deployed and shareable before the hour is up. Expect practical prompts, honest trade‑offs, and a reusable recipe you can take back to your team. Leave with a template, the prompts we used, and a clear playbook for running your own 60‑minute idea‑to‑prototype sprint.​ 

 Critical Skill : **Devops / Product Delivery**

 **Personal Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Andra Vasilcoiu​ & Victor Ruso

tabData.title: Designing for an AI Future
tabData.text:
Designing for an AI Future invites colleagues to step confidently into the next era of creativity and impact. In this session, we’ll explore how your design expertise, combined with the bank’s most advanced AI capabilities, can elevate what’s possible in your work. We’ll spotlight some of the Group’s most innovative technologies and show how AI can shift from an abstract concept to a practical, inspiring partner in your design process. 

 Critical Skill : **AI Strategy / Design & Implementation** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Tony Wood

tabData.title: Labs@LBG - Java Quarkus: Building Skills through Immersive Hands-on Learning
tabData.text:
A practical, interactive introduction to Quarkus from Labs@LBG, showcasing how engineers can rapidly build skills using secure, browser‑based labs. 

 Critical Skill : **Software Engineering / DevOps** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Vicky Stacey

tabData.title: IDP: From Zero to Hero
tabData.text:
In 80 minutes you will build an application using modern tools and techniques to create a production grade service. For those who have attended our previous reboot sessions, we will be exploring topics which will give you new insights and ideas, including building for resilience and test automation. 

 Critical Skill : **IT Platforms & Hosting** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Asa Harland

tabData.title: Building Context Aware AI systems
tabData.text:
Join us for a hands-on workshop where we transform AI agents from generic Q&A to personalised context aware systems accessing tools and handing off to other agents to solve problems. 

 Critical Skill : **AI / ML Solution Design / Product Innovation and Development** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Huw Corne & Azahar Machwe

tabData.title: Women ConnecTech: Wonderland in Action: a Python Workshop
tabData.text:
A Python workshop in Natural Language Processing to explore Alice in Wonderland. All skills levels in Python are welcome including absolute beginners.  
 Critical Skill : **Software Engineering / Data Literacy** 

 **Personal Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Halyna Maslak & Matilda Summers-Rose

tabData.title: Roast your Work - How AI can help you ensure you are delivering the right things for your customers
tabData.text:
This workshop will cover: How to use AI to sharpen problem statements, clarify customer value, and define work with greater precision. AI‑driven prompts help uncover hidden risks and dependencies early, improving alignment and decision‑making. By synthesising insights quickly, teams can prioritise smarter and ensure they’re delivering the right outcomes not just outputs. 
 
 Critical Skill : **Agile Delivery / Product Delivery** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Dee Adam

tabData.title: Supercharging Collaboration with SharePoint Agents
tabData.text:
Discover what SharePoint Agents are, how they can streamline teamwork, and join a live build‑along to set up your own agent in your SharePoint site. Perfect for makers and anyone looking to boost productivity.​  
 Critical Skill : **AI Literacy​** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Henry Wharton

tabData.title: Change Community Quick Hack
tabData.text:
Try something new, get hands‑on with tech, and explore fresh ideas with like‑minded change colleagues at our Reboot Change Hackathon. Go at your own pace, get plenty of support, and leave with a new skill, a real achievement, and a spark you can build on for the future.  
 Critical Skill : **Creativity & Innovative Thinking / Product Innovation and Development​**  

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Leo Mabbott-Clarke

tabData.title: Can you hack it as a Game Designer?
tabData.text:
Step into the shoes of a game designer and see if you can crack our latest challenge: 
 Create the concept, flow and play experience for a brand‑new Security Education & Awareness game. 
 This game must work both online and offline, blending digital interactivity with real‑world, hands‑on play. You’ll get a full briefing, plenty of support along the way and the freedom to get creative. 
 Bring your imagination, your curiosity and your best ideas. 
 May the best game win.  
 Critical Skill : **Creativity & Innovative Thinking** 

 **Connected LBG Laptop Required**
tabData.name: Andrew Dawson
